query: Under which boundary conditions (industry dynamism, ownership, regulation, firm age, national context) does purpose enable versus impede strategic renewal?

response.query: Under which boundary conditions (industry dynamism, ownership, regulation, firm age, national context) does purpose enable versus impede strategic renewal?
response.answer: Purpose enables strategic renewal in stable industries but can impede it in highly dynamic ones; firm age and national context also influence this dynamic.
